name: dsh-desktop
description: Tauri desktop wrapper around the DeepSeek Harness web application
$comment: The application version is not defined here: it lives in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json and is stamped from .dsh-version by scripts/set-version.mjs. There are deliberately no dependencies — every script resolves the Tauri CLI through npx, so `npm run` works after a plain checkout with no install step.

scripts.setup: node scripts/fetch-runtime.mjs && node scripts/trim-runtime.mjs && node scripts/prepare-bundle.mjs
